params.name: groupNames
params.description: Filled with group names as they appear in the Password editor window -- confirmed an array (not a scalar Text) by the doc syntax line 'groupNames : Text array'.

params.name: groupNumbers
params.description: Filled, in sync with groupNames, with the corresponding unique group ID numbers -- confirmed an array (not a scalar Integer) by the doc syntax line 'groupNumbers : Integer array'.

overloads.semanticRole: Fills groupNames and groupNumbers, in sync, with the names and unique IDs of every group in the Password editor.

constraints: In project databases, group ID numbers start at 15001 and are dynamically allocated at startup, maintained for the session; in binary databases, numbers are stored and fall in a range depending on the group creator.
